title: Avatar validation failed when Expression Parameters exceed the limit
symptom: The avatar cannot pass validation in the documented case.
trigger: The article's example exceeds the available Expression Parameters budget.
root_cause: The article identifies Expression Parameters usage over the limit for its documented case and explicitly warns that the same generic message can have other causes.
solution: Reduce parameters or remove/disable Modular Avatar items that consume unnecessary parameters.

title: New avatar upload rejected with “id is not allowed to be used” on an older SDK
error_signature: id is not allowed to be used. Make sure you're using SDK 3.9.0 or newer.
symptom: A newly created avatar cannot be uploaded.
trigger: Attempt to upload a new avatar with a VRChat SDK older than 3.9.0 in the documented environment.
root_cause: The article attributes the rejection to the outdated VRChat SDK requirement for new avatar uploads.
solution: Update VRChat SDK - Base and VRChat SDK - Avatars in VCC to 3.9.0 or newer.

title: World Build & Test blocked until Layers and Collision Matrix are configured
error_signature: You must address Layers and Collision Matrix issues before you can build.
symptom: Build & Test and online world upload are blocked.
trigger: Use a newly created world project whose VRChat-required Layers and Collision Matrix setup has not been applied.
root_cause: The SDK validation reports missing required Layers/Collision Matrix setup.
solution: Use the SDK setup actions for Layers and Collision Matrix, then build again.

title: XWear Packager cannot import XAvatar when MToon10 is missing
symptom: Importing an XAvatar through XWear Packager fails when the model shader dependency is absent.
trigger: Import a VRoid XAvatar without MToon10 available in the project.
root_cause: The article identifies the missing MToon10 shader dependency in its documented workflow.
solution: Install UniVRM (VRM 1.0), which provides MToon10, before importing the XAvatar.

title: XWear Packager cannot be installed when VRChat SDK - Avatars is too old
symptom: XWear Packager cannot be installed into a project with an older Avatar SDK.
trigger: Attempt to install XWear Packager with VRChat SDK - Avatars older than 3.7.1.
root_cause: The article states that XWear Packager depends on VRChat SDK - Avatars 3.7.1 or newer.
solution: Update VRChat SDK - Avatars in VCC before installing XWear Packager.

title: Build & Publish fails with Illegal byte sequence when the Windows device name is Japanese
error_signature: Illegal byte sequence encounted in the input. Parameter name: string
symptom: Build & Publish does not complete in the author's environment.
trigger: The field report reproduces the problem with a Japanese Windows PC/device name.
root_cause: The author reports that the Japanese device name was the cause in their environment after other path/name checks did not resolve it.
solution: Rename the PC/device to an alphanumeric name, reboot Windows, and retry Build & Publish.

title: Unsupported Unity version can prevent VRChat avatar builds and produce multiple errors
symptom: Build may not run and multiple errors may appear when using a non-supported Unity version.
trigger: Use a Unity version outside the VRChat-supported version in the article's troubleshooting scenario.
root_cause: The article attributes this class of failure to using an unsupported Unity version.
solution: Use Unity 2022.3.22f1 for the documented 2026 VRChat workflow.

title: Avatar renders pink when its shader is missing or not recognized
symptom: The avatar or accessory appears entirely pink.
trigger: The required shader was not installed, was removed, or the material points to a shader Unity cannot resolve.
root_cause: The article identifies a missing/unrecognized shader as the common cause for its documented symptom.
solution: Install the shader required by the avatar or asset, such as lilToon when appropriate, and verify the material's expected shader.

title: Avatar parts disappear in VRChat when objects remain tagged EditorOnly
symptom: An avatar or accessory is visible in Unity but disappears in VRChat.
trigger: The affected GameObject is left tagged EditorOnly before build.
root_cause: The article lists EditorOnly as one cause of objects being excluded from the built avatar.
solution: Remove the EditorOnly tag from objects that must be included in the avatar build.

title: VRM Converter for VRChat does not convert a VRM 1.0 export in the documented workflow
symptom: Dragging the VRM into Unity does not result in a convertible avatar in the author's workflow.
trigger: Export the VRoid model as VRM 1.0 instead of VRM 0.0 for the documented converter version.
root_cause: The article identifies VRM 1.0 as unsupported by the converter path it used.
solution: Export the model as VRM 0.0 for that workflow.

title: VRoid avatar remains Performance Poor because PhysBone metrics stay high
symptom: A simple VRoid avatar still reports Poor with multiple PhysBone-related warnings after adding Avatar Optimizer.
trigger: Use the author's VRoid export settings before reducing material count.
root_cause: The author reports that reducing the VRoid export material count to 2 removed the observed PhysBone-related Poor state in that specific test; the general causal mechanism is not established.
solution: Use the tested VRoid material-reduction setting and re-check the SDK performance report; treat this as a field-specific remedy, not a universal PhysBone fix.

title: Avatar upload can fail in a field report when AAO is present without ActualPerformanceWindow enabled
symptom: The author reports cases where pressing upload did not succeed after adding AAO Trace And Optimize.
trigger: Use the author's workflow without enabling ActualPerformanceWindow from anatawa12's gist pack.
root_cause: The article reports a correlation in its environment but does not establish a general root cause.
solution: Enable ActualPerformanceWindow in the documented workflow and retry; treat this as a field workaround.
workaround: Enable ActualPerformanceWindow and retry the upload.

title: World upload blocked by multiple Pipeline Manager components
error_signature: You can only have a single...
symptom: The SDK refuses to build/upload a world because more than one Pipeline Manager is present.
trigger: Import a world asset that includes a sample Pipeline Manager into a scene that already has one.
root_cause: The field guide identifies duplicate Pipeline Manager components in the scene.
solution: Use the SDK selection action to find all Pipeline Managers and remove the unintended duplicate.

title: VRChat Unity project repeatedly fails to open after FatalError
symptom: The Unity project remains unable to start after repeated launch attempts.
trigger: The article covers a project-specific fatal startup state after normal recovery attempts have failed.
root_cause: unknown
solution: As a last-resort recovery, create a clean VRChat project, verify the old scene can open, copy the scene, and reintroduce assets/tooling incrementally to isolate the failing dependency.
workaround: Rebuild the project incrementally from a clean project while preserving known-good scene/assets.

title: Clothes or hair disappear at some poses/view angles because skinned mesh bounds no longer cover the deformed mesh
symptom: Hair or clothing vanishes when the avatar crouches or is viewed near the edge of the camera frustum.
trigger: The deformed mesh moves outside a bounds box that remains around the original pose.
root_cause: The article attributes the visual disappearance to renderer bounds no longer enclosing the deformed mesh, causing culling.
solution: Adjust bounds so the expected deformed mesh remains inside the culling bounds and verify in relevant poses/views.

title: Clothing present in Unity is omitted from the VRChat build when left EditorOnly
symptom: Clothes are visible in Unity but absent after building and entering VRChat.
trigger: The clothing object remains tagged EditorOnly.
root_cause: The article identifies EditorOnly on the clothing object as the cause in this failure mode.
solution: Change the tag so the clothing is included in the build and verify in Play Mode/private VRChat.

title: Avatar clothing can be correct on PC but missing on mobile because the platform build diverged
symptom: The PC avatar is dressed correctly while mobile users see missing clothing.
trigger: The mobile/platform-specific avatar build omits clothing, retains EditorOnly, or has other configuration divergence.
root_cause: The article groups this symptom under mistakes in the separate platform build rather than the PC build.
solution: Verify the target-platform hierarchy/tags/parameters separately and test the mobile build before publication.

title: Avatar build blocked because particle collision forces target Pickup/Item layers
error_signature: This avatar contains one or more particle systems configured to apply collision forces to Pickups and/or Items. This is not allowed.
symptom: The SDK rejects the avatar because a particle system can apply collision forces to protected pickup/item layers.
trigger: Configure particle collision against the protected layers with non-zero collider force.
root_cause: The SDK validation message directly identifies the disallowed particle collision-force configuration.
solution: Remove those layers from particle collision or set collider force to zero, then rebuild.

title: CS0246 from FindMissingScripts.cs resolved by moving the editor utility into an Editor folder
symptom: A custom FindMissingScripts editor utility keeps producing CS0246 compilation errors.
trigger: Place the editor-only utility outside an Editor assembly/folder so editor APIs compile in the wrong context.
root_cause: The forum resolution identifies incorrect placement of the editor utility as the cause for the reported case.
solution: Move FindMissingScripts.cs into an Editor folder so it compiles as editor-only code.

title: Avatar upload validation reports “Chest bone is not specified”
symptom: The SDK blocks or warns during avatar upload because the humanoid Chest mapping is missing.
trigger: Use a Humanoid avatar whose rig/avatar configuration does not map a Chest bone.
root_cause: The forum diagnosis points to the missing Humanoid Chest mapping in the avatar rig.
solution: Open the model Rig configuration, configure the Humanoid avatar, and map the Chest bone to the correct skeleton transform.

title: Avatar build reports missing Body mesh or Armature after hierarchy changes
error_signature: Avatar is missing a Body mesh or Armature
symptom: The SDK build/upload path fails because expected avatar body/armature structure is missing or no longer valid.
trigger: Build an avatar after hierarchy/model changes that remove or invalidate required Body/Armature references.
root_cause: The forum report surfaces missing/invalid avatar hierarchy as the immediate validation failure; exact edit causing it is case-specific.
solution: Restore a valid avatar body/armature hierarchy and verify the Avatar Descriptor/model references before rebuilding.

title: SDK build aborts when the first Gesture animator layer has no valid mask
error_signature: Gesture Layer needs valid mask on first animator layer
symptom: The SDK build is aborted and the Builder reports an invalid/missing mask on the first Gesture layer.
trigger: Use a custom Gesture controller whose first layer has no valid Avatar Mask, or references a temporary mask that disappears during build.
root_cause: The forum diagnosis identifies the missing/temporary Gesture-layer Avatar Mask as a concrete validation problem; the thread also warns that editing a temporary VRCFury test copy can keep the build unreliable.
solution: Use a persistent valid mask such as the SDK sample vrc_HandsOnly on the original avatar's first Gesture layer and avoid temporary build-copy masks.

title: AvatarDynamicsSetup appears missing because Safe Mode prevented VRChat SDK scripts from loading
symptom: AvatarDynamicsSetup cannot be found and the project is in Unity Safe Mode.
trigger: Import assets that introduce compilation errors; in the confirmed follow-up, an asset brought UdonSharp scripts that caused compilation failures.
root_cause: The OP later reports that imported UdonSharp content caused compilation errors in the new-project reproduction; the old project remained unresolved.
solution: Remove the conflicting/unwanted UdonSharp scripts or otherwise clear the compilation errors so the VRChat SDK assemblies can load; a clean project worked for the OP.
workaround: Recreate the project and re-import assets selectively to isolate the conflicting package.

title: Quest avatar upload blocked because Unity Standard shader is unsupported
error_signature: Standard shader is not supported on Quest
symptom: The Android/Quest avatar build cannot be uploaded because materials use an unsupported shader.
trigger: Build a Quest avatar variant whose materials still use Unity's Standard shader.
root_cause: The platform validation identifies an unsupported shader for Quest/Android.
solution: Replace unsupported materials with VRChat Mobile-supported shaders and revalidate the Android build.

title: Modular Avatar Inspector fields disappear with no Console error until UserSettings is regenerated
symptom: Modular Avatar components remain present but all normal Inspector settings disappear while the Console shows no red error.
trigger: The field report observed a project-specific editor-state failure after the same package versions had previously worked; the exact trigger was not established.
root_cause: unknown
solution: Close Unity, rename/backup the project UserSettings folder, reopen Unity so UserSettings is regenerated, and confirm the MA Inspector returns.
workaround: Regenerate project UserSettings after backing it up; package reinstall and Library regeneration did not fix the author's case.
